functions.name: ensureClass
functions.docComment: /** Ensure a class exists in the map, creating a default if needed */

functions.name: parseMember
functions.docComment: /** Parse a class member line (attribute or method) */

functions.name: parseRelationship
functions.docComment: /** Parse a relationship line into a ClassRelationship */

functions.name: parseArrow
functions.docComment:
/**
 * Map arrow syntax to relationship type and marker placement side.
 * Prefix markers (`<|--`, `*--`, `o--`) place the UML shape at the 'from' end.
 * Suffix markers (`..|>`, `-->`, `..>`, `--*`, `--o`) place it at the 'to' end.
 */

functions.name: relationshipMarkerDefs
functions.docComment:
/**
 * Marker definitions for class relationship endpoints.
 * Each relationship type has a distinct marker:
 *   - inheritance: hollow triangle
 *   - composition: filled diamond
 *   - aggregation: hollow diamond
 *   - association: open arrow (simple >)
 *   - dependency: open arrow (simple >)
 *   - realization: hollow triangle (same as inheritance)
 *
 * Uses var(--_arrow) for fill/stroke and var(--bg) for hollow marker fills.
 */

functions.name: renderClassBox
functions.docComment:
/**
 * Render a class box with 3 compartments: header, attributes, methods.
 * Wrapped in <g class="class-node"> with semantic data attributes.
 */

functions.name: renderMember
functions.docComment:
/**
 * Render a single class member with syntax highlighting.
 * Uses <tspan> elements to color each part of the member differently:
 *   - visibility symbol (+/-/#/~) → textFaint
 *   - member name (incl. parens for methods) → textSecondary
 *   - colon separator → textFaint
 *   - type annotation → textMuted
 */

functions.name: renderRelationship
functions.docComment:
/**
 * Render a relationship line with appropriate markers and semantic attributes.
 * Includes data-* attributes for programmatic inspection.
 */

functions.name: getRelationshipMarkers
functions.docComment:
/**
 * Get marker-start/marker-end attributes for a relationship type.
 * Uses `markerAt` from the parser to place the marker on the correct end:
 *   - 'from' → marker-start (prefix arrows like `<|--`, `*--`, `o--`)
 *   - 'to'   → marker-end   (suffix arrows like `..|>`, `-->`, `--*`)
 */

functions.name: getMarkerDefId
functions.docComment: /** Map relationship type to its SVG marker definition ID */

functions.name: renderRelationshipLabels
functions.docComment: /** Render relationship labels and cardinality text (supports multi-line) */

functions.name: midpoint
functions.docComment: /** Get the midpoint of a point array */

functions.name: cardinalityOffset
functions.docComment: /** Calculate offset for cardinality label perpendicular to edge direction */

functions.name: escapeAttr
functions.docComment:
/**
 * Escape a string for use as an XML/HTML attribute value.
 * Escapes quotes and ampersands to prevent attribute injection.
 */

arguments:
`  <rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${width}" height="${height}" ` +
    `rx="0" ry="0" fill="var(--_node-fill)" stroke="var(--_node-stroke)" stroke-width="${STROKE_WIDTHS.outerBox}" />`

`  <rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${width}" height="${headerHeight}" ` +
    `rx="0" ry="0" fill="var(--_group-hdr)" stroke="var(--_node-stroke)" stroke-width="${STROKE_WIDTHS.outerBox}" />`

'  ' + renderMultilineText(
      cls.label,
      x + width / 2,
      nameY,
      FONT_SIZES.nodeLabel,
      `text-anchor="middle" font-size="${FONT_SIZES.nodeLabel}" font-weight="700" fill="var(--_text)"`
    )

`  <line x1="${x}" y1="${attrTop}" x2="${x + width}" y2="${attrTop}" ` +
    `stroke="var(--_node-stroke)" stroke-width="${STROKE_WIDTHS.innerBox}" />`

`  <line x1="${x}" y1="${methodTop}" x2="${x + width}" y2="${methodTop}" ` +
    `stroke="var(--_node-stroke)" stroke-width="${STROKE_WIDTHS.innerBox}" />`

renderMultilineText(rel.label, pos.x, pos.y - 8, FONT_SIZES.edgeLabel,
        `font-size="${FONT_SIZES.edgeLabel}" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="${FONT_WEIGHTS.edgeLabel}" fill="var(--_text-muted)"`)

renderMultilineText(rel.fromCardinality, p.x + offset.x, p.y + offset.y, FONT_SIZES.edgeLabel,
        `font-size="${FONT_SIZES.edgeLabel}" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="${FONT_WEIGHTS.edgeLabel}" fill="var(--_text-muted)"`)

renderMultilineText(rel.toCardinality, p.x + offset.x, p.y + offset.y, FONT_SIZES.edgeLabel,
        `font-size="${FONT_SIZES.edgeLabel}" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="${FONT_WEIGHTS.edgeLabel}" fill="var(--_text-muted)"`)
